name: Blademaster's Bonfires
summary: Yashiro asks you to light two bonfires in Dae'gun. Their flames will draw out the demons troubling the graves.

sections.title: A Test of Strength
sections.body: Yashiro speaks of a battle that ended before he answered his clans' call. Now he seeks a path up the mountain to a fallen stronghold. Demons profane the graves there, and he wants proof of your strength before fighting beside you. Light the two bonfires in Dae'gun and return to Yashiro; their flames will draw the enemy out.

sections.title: The Flames
sections.body: The bonfires will draw the demon commanders out. Yashiro sees this as a chance to end their reign.

faq.q: Who asks me to light the bonfires?
faq.answer: Yashiro asks you to light the two bonfires in Dae'gun.

faq.q: Why does Yashiro want the bonfires lit?
faq.answer: The flames draw the demons out, and Yashiro says they will bring the demon commanders out.
The two bonfires are in Dae'gun.

faq.q: Why does Yashiro test my strength?
faq.answer: Yashiro wants to know you are capable before he fights at your side.

faq.q: What is Yashiro seeking on the mountain?
faq.answer: Yashiro seeks a path up the mountain to a fallen stronghold near the summit.
